standard_prerequisites.name: Chain complexes in an abelian category
standard_prerequisites.statement: The category Ch(A) of chain complexes over an abelian category A, with its differentials d_n : A_n to A_{n-1} and the condition d squared = 0.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the setting of the statement (source lines 5335-5336).

standard_prerequisites.name: Homotopy between morphisms of complexes
standard_prerequisites.statement: Two morphisms a, b : A to B are homotopic when there are maps h_n : A_n to B_{n+1} with a_n - b_n = d h_n + h_{n-1} d.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the relation that the representing object must encode (source lines 5340-5341, 5410-5416).

standard_prerequisites.name: Representable functors
standard_prerequisites.statement: A chain complex C represents a functor F when Mor(C, -) is naturally isomorphic to F.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the form of the statement (source lines 5343-5346).

core_obligations: Construct the complex: set diamond A_n = A_n direct sum A_n direct sum A_{n-1} and define the differential by the explicit matrix, checking d squared = 0 (source lines 5352-5371).
From a morphism to a triple: unpack a morphism of complexes diamond A to B into two maps A to B and a homotopy between them (source lines 5371-5392).
From a triple to a morphism: assemble the components of a morphism diamond A to B out of a and b and the homotopy h, using the signs of the matrix (source lines 5392-5408).
Check the two constructions are inverse and that A to diamond A is functorial (source lines 5408-5416).

proof_roadmap.step: Define diamond A_n and its matrix differential, and verify d squared = 0.
Read the triple (a, b, h) off a morphism of complexes diamond A to B.
Build the morphism from a triple and check the composites are the identities.
Conclude the agreement of the two composites from the homotopy identity and note functoriality.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-represent-homotopy at source lines 5334-5350: for a chain complex A in an abelian category there is a chain complex diamond A whose representable functor sends B to the set of triples (a, b, h) with a, b : A to B and h a homotopy between them, and the construction is functorial in A. The proof at source lines 5352-5416 builds diamond A_n = A_n direct sum A_n direct sum A_{n-1} with an explicit matrix differential whose entries are the differential of A and the identity with signs, verifies d squared = 0, reads a morphism diamond A to B off a triple and conversely assembles a morphism from a triple, and closes by checking that the two composites agree exactly by the homotopy identity. It is a completely explicit construction; the substance is the sign pattern in the matrix that makes the homotopy relation become a chain map relation, and the card is self-contained (it invokes no other author result).
